title: Arab Medical Center — doctors and hospital details
notes: AMC publishes NO doctor directory: /doctors/ ("Clinics", linked as DOCTORS SEARCH) lists 27 clinic specialties only, and every "find a doctor" link on department pages points back to it. The only named physician page is one WordPress portfolio item (Dr. Kamal Akl). Facility record is rich (beds, ORs, ICU/CCU, cath labs, accreditations, 43 insurer logos transcribed). Homepage "Mon-Fri 8:30-17:00 / Saturday 9:30-13:00 / Sunday Closed" box appears to be theme placeholder text and was not used.
